card.name: Linking words before co-exposed drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "with" or "taking" that come after exposure, use or risk wording and just before a list of other drugs or agents. Seen mostly in methemoglobinemia and drug-risk passages.

modes.label: Exposed to
modes.description: The word "to" after "exposure" or "exposed", leading into oxidizing agents or nitrates.
modes.example: infants under 6 months of age, and concurrent exposure<< to>> oxidizing agents or their metabolites are

modes.label: Used with / taking
modes.description: "with" or "taking" linking a patient or use to other named drugs.
modes.example: Drugs That May Cause Methemoglobinemia When Used<< with>> Salicor™ Patients who are administered
